decision.explanation: The query asks for the conflict associated with 'Battle of Beirut'. The source documents identify three distinct historical events named 'Battle of Beirut' (or 'Siege of Beirut' in the third case), each associated with a different conflict: 1) D1S1 explicitly links 'Battle of Beirut (1912)' to the 'Italo-Turkish War'. 2) D2S1 links 'Battle of Beirut (1941)' to 'World War II' (specifically noting it ended hostilities in the Syria-Lebanon campaign). 3) D5S5 links the 'Siege of Beirut' (often referred to as the Battle of Beirut in this context) to the '1982 Lebanon War'. The candidate 'Syria-Lebanon campaign' (C3) is a specific campaign within World War II, but 'World War II' is the broader conflict explicitly stated in the source text as the association for the 1941 battle. All three identified conflicts are valid distinct answers corresponding to the different referents of the name 'Battle of Beirut' found in the text.
